structured_output.summary: The diff implements %TypedArray%.prototype.indexOf in its own file, one spec step per comment. Steps 1 to 7 run in spec order. ValidateTypedArray and ToIntegerOrInfinity propagate errors with `?`. Length is captured once and the loop re-checks k < length. The -1 returns for length 0 and not-found are correct. The local to_clamped_index follows ToAbsoluteIndex and then clamps. No test-shaped branches, hardcoded values, or swallowed errors appear in the diff. The one lint flag, an unreachable! after ValidateTypedArray, is truly unreachable because RequireInternalSlot already rejects non-objects. The ticket permits the local helper, and the gate reports no regressions.
